description: `prose --output jsonl status` under the default hosted harness prints the INVOCATION_INVALID envelope with `prose --output jsonl cli service triage`.

problem.action: Use `cli service triage`: `prose --output jsonl cli service triage`.

details.reason: `status` is a language command, which runs only with a local harness; did you mean `prose --output jsonl cli service triage`? Nothing was forwarded or sent. To run the language command, select a local harness with `prose cli harness use <id>`
